title: Round initialization instruction
statement: For each natural number $E$ and Boolean phase $p_h$, define a register-machine instruction on 17 registers and four deciders: if $p_h$ is true, clear register $K$ and continue at the state that sets $K$ to one; otherwise, clear register $k$ and continue at the first round state, with the phase set to true and the round index set to $E$.
